description_en: Queries the details of one or more instances
description_zh: 查询一个或多个实例的详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun airec list-instance --page 1 --size 10 --status Running --name '实例1' --expired-time 1608533404 --instance-id airec-cn-0000 --api-version 2020-11-26 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListInstance

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 10. Valid values: 1 to 50
parameters.help_zh: 指定每页展示条数，默认为10，限制:[1-50]
parameters.name: size

parameters.help_en:
The running status of the instances to filter.

Valid values:

Initializing: The instance is being initialized.

Ready: The instance is ready for data import.

Running: The instance is running
parameters.help_zh:
通过实例运行状态进行过滤。

取值：

Initializing：初始化中。

Ready：待数据导入。

Running：运行中
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The name of the instances to filter. Fuzzy matching is supported
parameters.help_zh: 通过实例名称进行过滤，支持模糊匹配
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: A UNIX timestamp in seconds. Use this parameter to filter for instances that are about to expire. Specify a time that is later than the current time. Expired instances are not included in the results
parameters.help_zh: 秒级时间戳，通过过期时间过滤，大于当前时间会过滤出即将过期的实例（不包含已经过期的实例）
parameters.name: expired_time

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instances to filter. Fuzzy matching is supported
parameters.help_zh: 通过实例ID进行过滤，支持模糊匹配
parameters.name: instance_id

code.description_en: The error code returned if the request fails

message.description_en: The error message returned if the request fails

chargeType.description_en:
The billing method of the instance.

Valid values:

PREPAY: Subscription.

POSTPAY: Pay-as-you-go
chargeType.description_zh:
实例付费类型。

取值：

PREPAY：预付费（包年包月）。

POSTPAY：后付费（按量付费）

commodityCode.description_en: The commodity code for the Airec service

dataSetVersion.description_en: The dataset version used by the online service
dataSetVersion.description_zh: 当前在线服务的数据集版本

expiredTime.description_en: The expiration time of the instance. The time is in UTC
expiredTime.description_zh: 实例过期时间，单位为UTC时间

gmtCreate.description_en: The creation time of the instance. The time is in UTC
gmtCreate.description_zh: 实例创建时间，单位为UTC时间

gmtModified.description_en: The last update time of the instance. The time is in UTC
gmtModified.description_zh: 实例最后更新时间，单位为UTC时间

industry.description_en:
The industry type of the instance.

Valid values:

content: Content-based.

item: E-commerce.

news: News
industry.description_zh:
实例行业类型。

取值：

content：内容型。

item：商品型。

news：新闻型

lockMode.description_en:
The lock status of the instance.

Valid values:

Unlock: Not locked.

ManualLock: Manually locked.

LockByExpiration: Locked due to an overdue payment
lockMode.description_zh:
实例锁定状态。

取值：

Unlock：未锁定。

ManualLock：手动锁定。

LockByExpiration：欠费锁定

regionId.description_en: The region ID of the instance

status.description_en:
The running status of the instance.

Valid values:

Initializing: The instance is being initialized.

Ready: The instance is ready for data import.

Running: The instance is running
status.description_zh:
实例运行状态。

取值：

Initializing：初始化中。

Ready：待数据导入。

Running：运行中

type.description_en:
The type of the instance.

Valid values:

Algorithm_configuration: Algorithm Configuration Edition.

Industry_operation: Industry Operation Edition.

Cold_start: Cold Start Edition
type.description_zh:
实例类型。

取值：

Algorithm_configuration：算法配置版。

Industry_operation：行业运营版。

Cold_start：冷启动版
